description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkModeGatewayConfigParser, verifying JSON parsing and default handling for TalkMode configuration in an Android app.

classes.name: TalkModeConfigParsingTest
classes.description: Unit test class for validating the parsing of TalkMode configuration JSON files, including handling of default values.

methods.name: readsMainSessionKeyAndInterruptFlag
methods.description: Tests parsing of main session key, interrupt flag, and silence timeout from JSON.

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenMissing
methods.description: Verifies that default silence timeout is used when the JSON key is missing.

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenInvalid
methods.description: Validates fallback to default when silenceTimeoutMs is invalid (zero).

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenString
methods.description: Checks that silenceTimeoutMs defaults when provided as a string instead of a number.
